trial_court: V Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Bengaluru, MC No.2791/2018
case_name: Dr Apoorve Sharma vs Bhargavi Sharma

parties.respondent_defendant: Bhargavi Sharma, wife and MS.Shruthi Lakhnpal, unknown role

facts_of_case: Petitioner filed for divorce under Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, which was dismissed by trial court. Petitioner then filed this writ petition to quash the order rejecting their interlocutory application.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to stay proceedings to demonstrate sufficient grounds for doing so.
legal_principles.held: During the pendency of the writ petition, both counsels submit that this writ petition is filed against the order dated 11.04.2023 in M.C No.2791/2018 passed by the V Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Bengaluru, on I.A No.4.

legal_principles.principle: A party seeking to stay proceedings must demonstrate sufficient grounds for doing so.
legal_principles.held: During the pendency of the writ petition, both counsels submit that this writ petition is filed against the order dated 11.04.2023 in M.C No.2791/2018 passed by the V Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Bengaluru, on I.A No.4.

outcome.final_order: Petition is dismissed as infructuous due to dismissal of divorce petition.
